-o.text:
1. Say Remixing before you work on your remix.
2. Duplicate the TEMP sprite and replace it with your character!
2A. Replace the costumes and the Voices. (You can port your character's result costumes and voices from "AY in The Results!" to here!)
3. Follow the Rules! ( https://justpaste.it/i8bkz )
4. After you have finished the character, add your character in the thumbnail and update the project name.
5. You can also add your music. (Please don't add more Results Music, there's already a lot...)

I recommend remixing in TurboWarp or with the Scratch Addons extension, it makes things much easier!
This project can handle about 30 players before question marks appear. If they occur, remix in Turbowarp!

= Debug Controls =
Press 0 before the game starts to test the KO, the order is from oldest to newest players.

also, delete INF_ASSETS for more asset space
